FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Threaded Roadbuilder
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Performance update: the calculation of the Minimum Spanning Tree for the road builder now uses threading!

patchNoteLines.li: Use a background thread for computation of the road builder MST

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Coalescing Settlement Terminology
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Replaces "colony" with "settlement" in the Empire UI when referring to Empire settlements.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates many UI strings to use "settlement" instead of "colony"

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Translation key update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates all of Empire's translation keys to use an "FC" prefix.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates translation keys that don't already have an "FC" prefix to have one. Touches many files.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Expanded production bonuses
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Expands the number of things that affect resource production. Now accounts for tile mutators, as well as a number of tile fields like rainfail, animal density, and pollution.

patchNoteLines.li: Buildings can now set tile mutator block/allowlists
New TileMutatorResourceExtension can be patched onto tile mutators to let them grant production bonuses/maluses
New ResourceProductionExtension_TileField allows various tile fields to affect resource production

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tech Progression Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates Empire's tech progression to be def-defined. This makes it much easier for other mods to change the thresholds for advancing the Empire faction's tech level. There's also a new mod setting to ignore research entirely and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player's (for use with mods like Tech Advancing).

patchNoteLines.li: New mod setting to ignore research and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player faction's
Change the tech level gates to be defined through XML

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Raid with no event fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Hardens the code against the possibility of a settlement falling under attack with no associated event.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds various protections to clean up a settlement's "under attack" state if there's no corresponding event

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Further "Settlement" Cleanup
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Further UI cleanup to get "settlement" everywhere it should be

patchNoteLines.li: More UI updates to use "settlement"

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Events backend update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Centralizes events. Mostly code bookkeeping.

patchNoteLines.li: Centralizes events into an FCEventManager that handles actually adding or removing events to the queue.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tile landmark support
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Expands the support for Tile Mutators to include Tile Landmarks.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new TileLandmarkResourceExtension that can be xml patched onto landmarks to make them grant special bonuses to Empire settlements.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Found Settlement Window Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new window on Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Biome Stat Modifiers
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Allows biomes to set biome-specific stat modifiers, in addition to the resource bonuses.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds and wires up a FCStatModifier list to BiomeResourceDef, enabling biomes to add bonuses or maluses to non-resource stats

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds several more defensive null guards.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds numerous null guards. Some are unlikely to ever trigger, but better safe than sorry...

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mercantile Diagnostics
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds some additional diagnostics to mercantile caravan spawning.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds diagnostic logging to the failure paths of Mercantile caravan spawning

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Improve RimWar Compatibility
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Improves RimWar compat by patching up some of *their* patches for Empire, and setting our own point calculation. A caveat: this patch fully hijacks RimWar's point calculation for Empire settlements. That makes it difficult to track the point cost for units, so the unit-spawning gizmos for Empire settlements have been disabled, to prevent cheesing. This might be revisited in the future, but for an old mod barely on life support, I'm considering this good enough for now.

patchNoteLines.li: Several harmony patches to improve Empire compatibility with RimWar

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Window Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple issues with the settlement window, and adds the ability for submods to add their own buttons to the bottom left panel.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: after recent translation key changes, the military stat wouldn't render in the settlement window
Adds an ISettlementWindowButton interface that can dynamically add buttons to the button left panel of the settlement window

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Road Builder Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds option to not use the threaded computations for the road builder, just in case some users run into problems with it.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a version of the road builder network calculations that runs on the main thread instead of a background thread

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Vehicle Framework Compatibility
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds compatibility with vehicle framework for sending vehicle caravans to manual battles.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a compatibility patch for Vehicle Framework to allow vehicle caravans to start manual battles.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Combat Extended compat fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with using CE mortars in fire support.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: using Empire's fire support feature with Combat Extended enabled can sometimes cause projectiles to go way off course

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: RimWar Compat Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Augments the RimWar compatibility patch to turn RimWar attacks on Empire settlements into Empire military events.

patchNoteLines.li: Augments the RimWar compat patch so that RimWar attacks on Empire settlements generate a military event that is resolved through Empire's own system

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Vehicle Framework Compat Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fix up the VF compat patch.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes up the Vehicle Framework compat patch

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Road Builder Updates! ...Again!
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the road network calculations to cache old results, and to also only consider each settlements' 8 closest neighbors.

patchNoteLines.li: Road MST computation: cache edge pathfinding results
Road MST computation: only calculate pathfinding costs for a settlement's 8 closest neighbors, instead of *all* settlements

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Cleans up some code, and minor performance changes.

patchNoteLines.li: Some minor performance-minded changes to WorldObjectComp_SettlementMilitary.CompTick
Cleans up the road builder code

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Trader Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the resource traders so that they don't offer to buy literally everything, including toxic wastepacks.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates the trader types added by Empire Refactored to not buy literally everything

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a minor bug in the UI for selecting alternate squads to defend an under-attack settlement.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: when a settlement is under attack, trying to assign a defensive squad through the settlement window can produce an error due to a translation string not receiving all three of its required arguments

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Processing Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Hardens the code against crashing events that wipe out the event log.

patchNoteLines.li: Catch errors from erroring events instead of letting them wipe out the event log

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Battle Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates manual battles to only end once the player has removed their own pawns from the map, similar to how the vanilla game handles map removal.

patchNoteLines.li: Instead of instantly removing a manual battle map when the battle ends, let the player move their own pawns off of the map

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Roads Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Add stone roads to Empire's road progression (dirt -> stone -> asphalt -> asphalt highway).

patchNoteLines.li: Adds stone roads to Empire's road progression.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Vanilla Biomes support
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds support for More Vanilla Biomes.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Various Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a handful of issues with the new delayed-end manual defense + some event resolution fixes.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: events sometimes won't resolve for unknown reasons, and remain in the queue with negative timers
Fixing various issues with new delayed-end manual defense

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Load Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds protections against null WorldSettlementFCs.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds protections against null WorldSettlementFCs in the FactionFc.settlements list

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Defense Shuttle Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense.

patchNoteLines.li: Various fixes to ensure that shuttles work properly with manual defense

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Cleans up a couple things that I should've caught before the 1.3.30 release...

patchNoteLines.li: Update the research tree so that the road and orbital techs aren't awkwardly clashing

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Battle Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where manual defense battles might not end after sending a supporting caravan and then withdrawing.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: sending a caravan to help with a manual defense battle and then pulling the pawns out could get the battle stuck

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Defense Skyfaller Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug with skyfallers (transport pods, shuttles) in manual defense battles.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: if attackers arrive to manual defense with transport pods, the battle may end prematurely

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Battle State Bug
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Bug: when saving+loading while a settlement is under attack (but before a defense has started), load order issues could cause the settlement to clear its own "isUnderAttack" flag, leading to bad state.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: settlements can lose their "isUnderAttack" state on save+load due to object loading order

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Defense UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple of UI bugs with auto-defense. No mechanical issues; only the UI had a problem.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: the translation key for the letter that reports an auto-defender was missed in the recent translation key update
Change: the currently-defending settlement is marked as such when choosing defenders through the world map gizmo

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Animal Check Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug where a pawnKindDef with a null race or race.race could break one of Empire's checks for animals. I don't *think* either of these fields are meant to be null, but Rimworld seemingly allows it, so, *shrug*. We at least log the pawnkinddef in question so we know which one needs fixing.

patchNoteLines.li: Add null guards in IsAnimalAndAllowed

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Prisoner Saving Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Pawns held as prisoner by Empire settlements can be double-deep scribed under some circumstances, resulting in errors on loading a save.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: Empire prisoner pawns are sometimes Scribe_Deep twice, resulting in a litany of errors on loading the save

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Caravan Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the ability to reform caravans after a manual defense battle.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: after winning (or losing) a manual defense battle, the typical "Reform Caravan" gizmo would not appear

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Caravan Gizmo Update 2
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Rimworld logic says that a battle is over as soon as hostiles start to flee; this is when the Reform Caravan gizmo appears. Empire, however, does not consider a battle to be over until all hostiles have died or fled the map. This creates an awkward interim period where the gizmo appears, but isn't fully usable. This update resolves that by disabling the gizmo until Empire says the battle is over.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: the Reform Caravan gizmo can appear before Empire says the battle is actually over

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Stuck Defense Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds load-time and debug-action-triggered checks to clear settlements that are erroneously stuck in the "Defending [settlement name]" state. I'm not completely sure what the root cause of the bug is, but this should at least clear up the resulting corrupted state.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: settlements sometimes get stuck in a "Defending [settlement name]" state

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of minor fixes.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: a malformed pawnKindDef could cause errors when determining which pawnkinds can be pack animals
Bugfix: some translation keys were missed in the update from a week or so ago

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: More null hardening for IsAnimalAndAllowed, used to fill out the animal pawnkind caches.

patchNoteLines.li: Add more null checks when processing pawnKindDefs for the pawnkind caches

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Evasion Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Patches an exploit where workers could be all unassigned right before tax is due to minimize the upkeep paid, while coasting by on income being calculated by the period average.

patchNoteLines.li: Settlements now track a periodic average of their upkeep.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Missing translation key
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Add missing translation key for the prosperity lost base stat.

patchNoteLines.li: Add FCTraitDesc_prosperityLostBase translation key

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI Update for Estimated Income
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates UI displays for estimated income to show the period average, which is what the player will actually receive

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Shattered Empire trader fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The defName for Empire Refactor's settlement traderkind collided with the base game's traderkind for the Shattered Empire, causing the actual Empire to generate stock oddly, or not at all. ...Really ought to've changed the mod name when I had the chance. Oh well.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: Base_Empire_Standard traderKindDef collides with the traderKindDef used for the base game's Shattered Empire faction

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Mods that define a pawnKindDef with a null race field can crash various aspects of Empire.

patchNoteLines.li: Remove RaceProps null check in ValidPawnKindDef. PawnKindDef.RaceProps is just a property that accesses race.race, so race being null crashes the access. The following null check on pawnKindDef.race?.race is sufficient.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: More hardening of pawnKindDef handling. Hopefully, this time, we won't see any more pawnKindDef-related errors. Hopefully.

patchNoteLines.li: Further hardening of Empire's pawnKindDef handling

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Asteroids & Ammo
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fix for an issue with the capital spot on asteroids, and a small tweak to the Combat Extended patch.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: due to int/PlanetTile conversion, the capital location update for the Capital Spot building is broken on non-surface layers, resulting in gravship bases getting bombarded with "Empire Relocated" messages
Tweak: CE compat: increase the number of mags that pawns start with from 3 to 6

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Caravan Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Delays the construction of caravan traderkinds so that actually valid lists are created.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes a bug where, after loading a save, the Empire faction would not have any valid caravan traders until a tax tick occurred

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Empire Caravan Refinement
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Refines the specialized resource trader caravans: there is now a cap on the number of distinct items they carry, which should mitigate issues such as animal traders arriving with a thousand different animals.

patchNoteLines.li: Refines Empire caravans to carry far fewer distinct items

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Faction-level Resource Display Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with the faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts not being correct.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: due to load-ordering issues, faction-level "Total Production" resource readouts are incorrect when loading a save

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Defense Hediff Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Manual Defense battles will apply "well-trained" or "poorly-trained" hediffs to pawns based on the military efficiency of their home settlement/faction. However, this hediff isn't always stripped once the battle is over, allowing the player to obtain buffed pawns. This patch corrects that.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: strip the combat efficiency hediff whenever a pawn is despawned (e.g. leaves the map or joins a caravan)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Resource Caravan Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the Empire-specific resource caravans to cap the number of pawns that the caravan can generate. Only relevant for the animals resource today, but should be able to handle any future resource that also would spawn pawns.

patchNoteLines.li: Cap animal spawns for animal caravans to 15.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Combat Efficiency Hediff Infocard Change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the infocard for the combat efficiency hediff to explain that the hediff's bonuses are derived from the faction's military efficiency.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates infocard for combat efficiency hediff

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fire Support Targeting Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes the targeting circle for Fire Support to draw persistently, instead of just when the camera is moving.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: targeting circle for fire support would only render while the camera is moving

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mercantile Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: When RimWar is active, trader caravans from the Mercantile policy can fail to spawn and spam the log with errors. The root bug is ultimately on RimWar's side, but this patch hardens Empire's code to more gracefully handle such errors.

patchNoteLines.li: Set the mercantile trader as a forced event so it doesn't get suppressed by the storyteller or third-party patches
Wrap the caravan spawning processing in a try/catch so we can still update the next arrival tick if an error occurs

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Capital-less Mercantiles
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Previously, trader caravans sent by the Mercantile Policy would fail to show up if the player hadn't set a capital location. With this patch, they now *will* show up.

patchNoteLines.li: Merantile caravans use TaxMap instead of ReturnCapitalMap(). TaxMap actually falls through to the player's active colony if neither a capital nor a tax spot are set

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Reduce VRAM usage
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Did you know that many of Empire's textures were over 1000 pixels on a side? I sure didn't. But thanks to that, Empire would use a whopping 600MB+ of VRAM!\n\nThis patch shrinks all those icons to more reasonable sizes, thereby reducing Empire's VRAM usage to only about 36MB.

patchNoteLines.li: Shrink faction icons to 256x256, and shrink trait icons to 128x128
Remove redundant texture loads in TexLoad

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Xenotype Filtering Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Removes the naive name filter that would mark any xenotype as non-violent if its defName contained "pacifist", "gentle", "weak", "frail", "nearsighted", or "peaceful".

patchNoteLines.li: Removes the naive name filter for xenotypes

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Translation Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates several non-English translations to remove a translation key collision with the base game.

patchNoteLines.li: Change non-English translation keys: TotalValue -> FCTotalValue

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Merc Needs Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Empire sets merc needs to full before they're deployed, but modded races can mess with this check. This update makes the checks stricter.

patchNoteLines.li: Gate needs checks behind RaceProps.Humanlike instead of !AnimalOrWildMan()

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Vehicle Framework Compat Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting can result in both the vehicle and the pawns within being swallowed and spat into the void upon battle conclusion.

patchNoteLines.li: When checking if it's safe to delete a map, check AllPawnsSpawned with a faction filter, rather than checking FreeColonistsSpawned

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: HAR Compatability Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A military unit that is created with a HAR race will lose that race when saving the game. This is a side-effect of how Empire handles pawnkinds.\n\nThis update fixes that bug.

patchNoteLines.li: Store a direct reference to the unit's race in MilUnitFC, so that when we load the unit, we can restore the correct pawnKind

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Races Fixes 2
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where, if a race is set to 0 weight in the xenotype/race filter, then any mercs created with that race will have their race silently swapped later on.

patchNoteLines.li: If a designed unit has a set race, then always use that race, even if it has weight 0 in the faction's xenotype filter

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Spot Delivery Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where getting taxes delivered without an active tax spot may cause errors and send all of your tax items into the void.

patchNoteLines.li: When finding the tax map, don't clobber an already-found map with a null value just because CheckForActiveTaxDeliverySpot returned false

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Cost Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The SettlementTypeExtension would cache a reference to the main world component, but never invalidate it. This could lead to things like settlement cost evaluations referring to the wrong world component. This update fixes that, and a couple of other minor issues.

patchNoteLines.li: Don't cache the FactionFC WorldComponent in SettlementTypeExtension
Skip invalid events in ValidateSettlementCaravansList()
Snapshot settlement cost in the settle confirmation dialog so the actual cost paid matches what the user sees in all cases

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Save-Load Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug where an entirely-derived list is still saved and loaded, introducing the possibility for a corrupted save or weird behavior to null it out. This then causes crashes and issues later on.

patchNoteLines.li: Don't scribe FactionFC.factionResources. It's always fully rebuilt after loading, so saving it is pointless

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Added Diag
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds some diagnostic logging for the failure case of failing to spawn a Mercantile caravan. The added logging fires only when a caravan fails to spawn, which happens at maximum once every 2 days.

patchNoteLines.li: Add BuildPawnGroupMakerDiagnostic for increased diag logging when a mercantile caravan fails to spawn
XenotypeFilter.ValidatePawnGroupMakers now also validates that trader makers have valid carriers

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Empire Trade Caravan Diagnostics
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a little bit of diagnostic logging for Empire trade caravans. The logging runs rarely, and should not impact performance.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds diagnostic logging showing when a player's selection of animal carriers doesn't cover the biome of their colony
Also adds a small patch for RimWar to force Vassal status on the Empire faction
